summary: to_yaml converts a variable into a YAML string via PyYAML yaml.dump to retain a string form.
questions: How do I convert a variable into a YAML string?

answer_card.title: to_yaml filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | to_yaml }}` converts a variable into a YAML string using PyYAML's `yaml.dump`, so it stays a string instead of being auto-converted.
